statement: Declared before any positivity-constrained OSB number on the real problem exists. Prototyping used synthetic problems only (records listed below). The real operands were used before this point only for D-ID's own admission checks, the bitwise reproduction of D-ID's committed T2 widths by D-ID's own widths() code, and the null-mode structure (eigenvalues, zero-efficiency cells, proportional columns): no OSB number, constrained or not.

governing.binding: docs/orchestration/state/measurement-paper/BINDING-PHASE1-20261019.md section 2 (MP4-A frozen; psi2 = chi2_1 quantile at 0.6827)

solver.inner: scipy.optimize.lsq_linear(G, -s u, bounds=(-t, inf), method='bvls', tol=1e-12, max_iter=6915 = 5 n); statuses 1, 2, 3 accepted, 0 and -1 are inner failures (the endpoint is then unresolved)
solver.outer: Lagrangian search in s = 1/(2 mu): start s0 = psi/||u|| (exact when positivity is idle), bracket by doubling (up to s0*1e12), then Illinois regula falsi on sqrt(g(s)) - psi with bisection safeguard; converged when |g(s)/psi2 - 1| <= 1e-9; at most 60 inner calls per endpoint
solver.positivity_floor: for a lower endpoint with h >= 0 (componentwise), h.lam >= 0 is implied by positivity; a feasible evaluated point (g <= psi2 (1 + 1e-9)) with h_r.delta <= -h.t + 1e-6 |h.t| is optimal and ends the search (status positivity-floor)
solver.certificates_reported: Lagrange dual value and best feasible value per endpoint (their gap), lsq_linear statuses, and a KKT residual on lsq_linear's active set (diagnostic only for trf, whose active mask is tolerance-based)

exact_reductions: G = diag(sqrt(lambda_+)) V_+^T from numpy.linalg.eigh of D-ID's fisher(R, t, b) on D-ID's positive set lambda > 1e-12 max; ||G delta||^2 = delta^T F delta on the kept space; null modes checked against the sparse whitened response
u = diag(lambda_+^-1/2) V_+^T h so that h_r.delta = u.(G delta) with h_r = V_+ V_+^T h; non-hole functionals (D-ID null fraction <= 1e-6) are solved with h_r
Z: weight h_j > 0 on a zero-efficiency truth cell j: max = +inf (proved: lam_j is absent from the ball and bounded only below); the min sets lam_j = 0 (h with those entries zeroed)

P: exactly proportional response columns (identical sparsity pattern, constant ratio to 1e-12): merged into one cell w = sum alpha_i lam_i with coefficient min_i h_i/alpha_i (lower endpoint) or max_i h_i/alpha_i (upper endpoint); applied only where the null fraction after Z exceeds 1e-6
anything else with null fraction > 1e-6 after Z and P, or any endpoint whose search does not converge: unresolved (never solved by another method)

gating_control.rule: positivity off, every reported functional (J 109, H2 27, EW 39): OSB half-width relative to |h.t| against D-ID tables.npz 'T2/nominal/widths_nom/sigma_rel' to 1e-6 relative, and identical hole sets (sigma = inf <=> null fraction > 1e-6)
gating_control.radius_composition_flag: With psi2 = chi2_1(0.6827) the unconstrained OSB half-width is exactly psi*sigma, psi - 1 = 2.17e-5 > 1e-6, so the gate read literally at the frozen radius cannot pass for a correct solver. Both readings are computed and reported: (i) at unit radius psi2 = 1, and equivalently the frozen-radius half-width divided by psi, against sigma_rel to 1e-6 (the machinery test); (ii) literal. The run proceeds on reading (i) and the literal reading's result is reported and FLAGGED for the director.
gating_control.stop: if reading (i) fails or the hole sets differ, nothing else is computed

pass_rule: J (RD1) at grid T2: median relative half-width <= 0.10 AND 90th percentile <= 0.25 (numpy default linear quantile, extended to +inf: a neighbour with nonzero interpolation weight that is +inf gives +inf). Computed with holes (proved-infinite and unresolved) as +inf, and excluding the D-ID holes (null fraction > 1e-6); if the two verdicts differ the verdict is reported as a decision for the director. H2 descriptive.
statistic_convention_note: the PLAN's 28.7% J floor (phase0 did_floor.py) is the median with holes as +inf, the same convention

budget.order: J endpoints first, then H2; endpoints beyond the cap are reported not-run

amendment_1.reason: Run 1 of the osb stage under v1 (osb-run1-aborted.log) returned lsq_linear status 0 or -1 (inner failure) on 51 of the first 138 endpoints. It was killed before it wrote any endpoint value; no OSB endpoint, half-width or statistic from run 1 was written or read (the log holds statuses, eval counts and CPU only). Diagnosis on two failing J inner calls at s0 (functional rows 46 min, 47 min), reading only lsq_linear status, iterations, CPU and the inner least-squares cost: trf returned status -1 (185 it) and 0 (1000 it); bvls on the same calls returned status 1 in 2 and 4 iterations (1.2 and 2.4 CPU-s) with lower inner cost (7.0472e-2 vs 7.1010e-2; 3.15089e-3 vs 3.15092e-3), i.e. trf also stops short of the inner optimum. bvls (exact active set, the same lsq_linear) is therefore the inner method; its synthetic agreement with trf and SLSQP is in the prototype records.
amendment_1.unchanged: radius, positivity as the sole constraint, outer search and its tolerance (g_rtol 1e-9), positivity floor, hole reductions Z and P, gate rule and its radius flag, PASS rule, quantile convention, inputs, budget cap
amendment_1.gate: re-run under this code (the v1 gate record is kept as gate-v1.json; it used only the unconstrained path, which is lsq_linear's lstsq branch, status 3, for either method)
